segments.text:
V. 17.
And lo a voice—We have here a glorious Manifeſtation of the ever bleſſed Trinity: The Father ſpeaking from Heaven, the Son ſpoken to, the Holy Ghoſt deſcending upon Him. In whom I delight—What an Encomium is this! How poor to this are all other Kinds of Praiſe! To be the Pleaſure, the Delight of GOD, this is Praiſe indeed: This is true Glory: This is the higheſt, the brighteſt Light, that Virtue can appear in.
